analyst_view.overall: A relegation six-pointer the AD has nicknamed the 'mismanagement derby': ADO Den Haag are 17th with 9 points and FC Utrecht 15th with 12 after 13 games, and Utrecht have conceded 37 goals, the second most in the league. Both clubs have changed coach this month: ADO brought in Maurice Steijn, who lost 3-0 at Ajax on his return after Matteo Waem was sent off (his ban is in the numbers), and Utrecht sacked Anthony Correia last Sunday, so interim Mark Otten takes his first game. Utrecht winger Angel Alarcon and full-back Niklas Vesterlund trained apart this week with injuries (FCUtrecht.net), which the numbers don't list, and Engwanda, Jensen and Paredes are back in training but not match-fit (already counted as out); ADO miss only striker Luka Reischl (groin, counted). Pundits expect Steijn to make ADO more solid, and Utrecht's board wants Otten to cut the goals conceded, so I lean a little lower on goals and shots. Serdar Gozubuyuk referees; the numbers already add about 37% to cards for his record (3.9 a game).

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals, high because both defences leak (ADO 28 conceded, Utrecht 37), and they already add about +6% for Utrecht because ADO defender Waem is banned. I lean lower to about 3.4: Utrecht's interim coach has been told to fix the defending first, Steijn is expected to make ADO harder to break down, and Utrecht are likely without winger Alarcon and full-back Vesterlund, neither of whom the numbers count.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners, with Utrecht taking a bit more (5.0) and recent form already counted (ADO slightly below expected, Utrecht slightly above). Losing Alarcon and Vesterlund takes some width from Utrecht's right side, but a more cautious ADO could also concede more corners by defending deep; nothing points clearly, so I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards, already up about 37% because referee Serdar Gozubuyuk shows 3.9 a game, and with Utrecht's busier recent card count in. I do not add for him again; I lean mildly higher, to about 4.9, only for the stakes the numbers don't flag: a bottom-four meeting between two clubs in crisis, after ADO picked up a red card and a late heavy challenge at Ajax.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.4 shots and already add about 15% to Utrecht for their recent shot volume against an ADO side that has allowed many. Utrecht now lack Alarcon, one of their regular starters in attack, and have a caretaker focused on defending, while Steijn wants a tighter ADO, so I trim a little, to about 30.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target (4.9 ADO, 5.8 Utrecht), with recent form already counted on both sides. Without Alarcon Utrecht lean more on striker Artem Stepanov, and both coaches are expected to start cautiously, so I trim a little, to about 10.5.
